parsed.attack: Two-sided referral requires the person on the other end to install, but what they receive is a warm personal text from a friend - complete value, nothing to install, and no sign software was involved. The loop can only turn if the sender discloses that the message was drafted for them, which is the single fact that devalues the message and embarrasses both parties, so this referral mechanic is self-cancelling by construction. The audience is defined as people who deleted Facebook and Instagram, meaning they have deliberately removed themselves from every free broadcast surface a zero-budget founder could use, and the idea's own kill line - 0.15 installs per paying user in 90 days - is a coefficient half the bottom of the healthy 0.3-0.7 band on a quarterly cycle.
parsed.strongest_defence: r/digitalminimalism and r/nosurf are hundreds of thousands of people who left the networks and openly grieve losing touch with friends: a dense, free, perfectly targeted congregation, and the product needs no second installer to be worth paying for.
parsed.verdict_reason: The claimed two-sided referral cannot turn without disclosing the fact that ruins the product, though a free targeted forum channel still reaches the first users.
